Module-level pytestmark = pytest.mark.from_latex anchors P7-1's previously-empty marker family (was 0 collected, now 2). Per-test stack: @slow + @e2e + @integration.
Surface-2 deliverable: test_deliverables_present_at_surfaces asserts dev/examples/run_compile_latex.py (P7-3) imports compile_latex and embeds % mechanics directives.

Acceptance test verifies the FULL canonical contract: parse, compile, emit Taichi (assert 'import taichi as ti' + '@ti.kernel' in emitted_source), JIT-compile, solve, compare to handwritten reference. Newton-sanity guards prevent false-pass.
